Name: Cessna 172 Preflight
Description: Standard preflight inspection for Cessna 172 Skyhawk.

Steps.Title: Cabin
Steps.Description: Verify ignition off, seats/belts secured, circuit breakers in.

Steps.Title: Fuel
Steps.Description: Check fuel quantity, quality, vents, and filler caps.

Steps.Title: Empennage
Steps.Description: Check horizontal stabilizer, elevator, rudder, trim tab, tie-down removed.

Steps.Title: Right Wing
Steps.Description: Check aileron, flap, wing tie-down, pitot tube, fuel tank, fuel sump.

Steps.Title: Nose
Steps.Description: Check propeller, cowling, oil level, landing light, nose wheel tire.

Steps.Title: Left Wing
Steps.Description: Check pitot tube removal, fuel tank, fuel sump, wing tie-down, flap, aileron.
